title: Ralpr Confidence Output
description: Output schema for phase confidence calculations (Cumulative Additive Model)

phase.description: Which phase this confidence is for

confidence.description: Overall confidence score as percentage (40 + cumulative_score for review)

cumulative_score.description: Total points accumulated across all iterations

points_earned.description: Points earned in this iteration (after multiplier)

threshold.description: Target threshold for this phase (default: 90 for review, 95 for refactor)

breakdown.description: Component scores that make up the iteration points (review phase)

tests_passed.description: Whether all tests passed (+4 points if true)

high_severity_count.description: Count of critical + important issues (+3 if 0, +1 if <=1)

approved_count.description: Number of APPROVED verdicts (+3 if all, +1 if >=2)

skill_confidence.description: Confidence from refactor skill (refactor phase only)

test_stability.description: 1.0 if tests pass, 0.0 if fail (refactor phase only)

label_set.description: The label set on the PR (e.g., 'ralpr:review:65')
